name: Camelot Hills
lore: The green hills below Camelot. Arthur is gone to Avalon and the Round Table's survivors keep the realm - but the roads are full of bandits paid in red-sealed silver, the dead are walking in the barrow fields, and in Mithra's old tomb the Crimson, Morgana le Fay's mortal cult, has begun its first rite under Camelot's nose.

chains.title: The Road Gang's Toll
chains.hint: Smoke from the Road Gang's camp in the hills east of the crossroads...

stages.name: Clear the Road Gang's Camp
stages.objective: Clear the Road Gang's camp in the hills
stages.announce: Ranulf Blackhand's band has made camp in the hollow and robs every cart bound for Prydwen. Break the camp.
stages.success: You have cleared the bandit hollow. Ranulf Blackhand comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the bandit hollow. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Ranulf Blackhand
stages.objective: Defeat Ranulf Blackhand
stages.announce: Ranulf Blackhand, the Road Gang's paymaster, comes out with a purse of red-sealed silver on his belt. 'Paid to keep the Watch busy, friend. Nothing personal.'
stages.success: Ranulf Blackhand falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Ranulf Blackhand slips away - for now.

stages.name: Ranulf's Men Hold the Camelot Road
stages.objective: Drive the bandits off the Camelot road
stages.announce: Ranulf Blackhand's bandits have come down to the Camelot road and set a toll. Nobody passes without paying - in coin or in blood.
stages.success: The bandits are gone from the road. The watch will want their toll gate down.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Wainwright Godric, who is pulling down the bandits' toll gate
stages.announce: Wainwright Godric is pulling down the toll gate. The bandits are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "Down it comes! Cotswold's road is free again."
stages.success: The bandits break and scatter. The road to Prydwen Keep is open again.
stages.fail: Wainwright Godric falls, and the bandits take the road back.

chains.title: The Barrow Wakes
chains.hint: Red lights in the barrow fields, and the dead are walking...

stages.name: Protect Brother Aelred
stages.objective: Protect Brother Aelred, who is unsaying the Crimson's call over the barrow
stages.announce: Brother Aelred, Brother Idris's curate, has come to unsay the red-robes' call over the barrow. The dead have heard him.
stages.success: "That's done," says Brother Aelred. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Brother Aelred falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Old Barrows
stages.objective: Clear the old barrows
stages.announce: They came from the old barrows. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the old barrows. The Barrow-Wight comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the old barrows. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Barrow-Wight
stages.objective: Defeat the Barrow-Wight
stages.announce: The Barrow-Wight stands at the old barrows. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Barrow-Wight falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Barrow-Wight slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Dead Hold the Road to Prydwen Keep
stages.objective: Drive the dead off the road to Prydwen Keep
stages.announce: With The Barrow Wakes lost, the large skeletons have spread down onto the road to Prydwen Keep and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The large skeletons are gone from the road to Prydwen Keep. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Mabyn, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Mabyn has come out to set the road to Prydwen Keep right. The large skeletons are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Prydwen Keep is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The large skeletons break and scatter. The road to Prydwen Keep is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Mabyn falls, and the large skeletons take the road back.

chains.title: The Dragon Ant Nest
chains.hint: Sergeant Wystan is gathering the Wardens in Cotswold to burn the ant queen's mound.

giver.name: Sergeant Wystan
giver.greet: The dragon ants have dug into the farmers' fields again - they took a whole flock last night. I'm taking the watch out to burn the nest. Will you come? Tell me when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Dragon Ant Nest
stages.objective: Go with Sergeant Wystan to the dragon ant nest
stages.announce: Sergeant Wystan leads the Cotswold watch out towards the dragon ant nest.
stages.success: Sergeant Wystan reaches the dragon ant nest. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Sergeant Wystan falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Dragon Ant Nest
stages.objective: Clear the dragon ant nest
stages.announce: Clear the dragon ant nest!
stages.success: You have cleared the dragon ant nest. The Hive Champion comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the dragon ant nest. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Hive Champion
stages.objective: Defeat the Hive Champion
stages.announce: The Hive Champion stands at the dragon ant nest. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Hive Champion falls. Cotswold will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: The Hive Champion slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Dragon Ant Workers Hold the Road to Cotswold Village
stages.objective: Drive the dragon ant workers off the road to Cotswold Village
stages.announce: With The Dragon Ant Nest lost, the dragon ant workers have spread down onto the road to Cotswold Village and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The dragon ant workers are gone from the road to Cotswold Village. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Edith, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Edith has come out to set the road to Cotswold Village right. The dragon ant workers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Cotswold Village is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The dragon ant workers break and scatter. The road to Cotswold Village is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Edith falls, and the dragon ant workers take the road back.

chains.title: The Orchard Raiders
chains.hint: Guardsman Pell is looking for help in Cotswold.

giver.name: Guardsman Pell
giver.greet: The spriggarn are stripping the Cotswold orchards bare - and dancing on what's left. The Reeve wants them taught manners. Will you come? Tell me when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Spriggarn Thicket
stages.objective: Go with Guardsman Pell to the spriggarn thicket
stages.announce: Guardsman Pell leads a few of Cotswold's newest adventurers out against the spriggarn.
stages.success: Guardsman Pell reaches the spriggarn thicket. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Guardsman Pell falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Spriggarn Thicket
stages.objective: Clear the spriggarn thicket
stages.announce: Clear the spriggarn thicket!
stages.success: You have cleared the spriggarn thicket. Old Knotbark comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the spriggarn thicket. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Old Knotbark
stages.objective: Defeat Old Knotbark
stages.announce: Old Knotbark stands at the spriggarn thicket. Bring friends.
stages.success: Old Knotbark falls. Cotswold will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: Old Knotbark slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Spriggarns Hold the Road to Cotswold Village
stages.objective: Drive the spriggarns off the road to Cotswold Village
stages.announce: With The Orchard Raiders lost, the spriggarns have spread down onto the road to Cotswold Village and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The spriggarns are gone from the road to Cotswold Village. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Edith, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Edith has come out to set the road to Cotswold Village right. The spriggarns are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Cotswold Village is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The spriggarns break and scatter. The road to Cotswold Village is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Edith falls, and the spriggarns take the road back.

chains.title: The Crimson Rite
chains.hint: Chanting under the eastern hill, and red light in the mouth of Mithra's Tomb...

stages.name: The Rite Stone
stages.objective: Keep Brother Cynan alive while he breaks the rite stone
stages.announce: The Crimson are holding their rite tonight! Brother Cynan of the eastern hamlet has gone to break the rite stone in the barrow fields - and the dead are rising to stop him.
stages.thanks: "It's broken! Now - the tomb. Whoever leads the rite is still chanting."
stages.success: The rite stone cracks. In the tomb mouth the chanting falters, then starts again, louder.
stages.fail: Brother Cynan falls, and the rite goes on into the night.

stages.name: The Tomb Mouth
stages.objective: Break the Crimson at the mouth of Mithra's Tomb
stages.announce: To the tomb! Cut down the red-robes before they finish the rite!
stages.success: The red-robes break - and the Hierophant comes up out of the dark.
stages.fail: The Crimson hold the tomb.

stages.name: Hierophant Cadan
stages.objective: Defeat Hierophant Cadan of the Crimson
stages.announce: Hierophant Cadan, in red over a Roman breastplate: 'The Lady sleeps in no one's shadow. Not even her brother's.' This is a fight for a group.
stages.success: Hierophant Cadan falls on the tomb's threshold, and every dead thing in the barrow fields lies down. The Watch will hear of this in Camelot.
stages.fail: Cadan finishes the rite. Something under the hill has heard.

stages.name: The Crimson Hold the Barrow Road
stages.objective: Drive the Crimson and their dead off the barrow road
stages.announce: The rite went on. The Crimson and their risen dead have come out onto the barrow road and turn back anyone who passes.
stages.success: The road is clear again.

chains.title: The Hunt Rides
chains.hint: Horns in the eastern hills, and hounds baying at something that isn't there...

stages.name: The Hunt in Full Cry
stages.objective: Turn the Difwych hunt in the eastern hills
stages.announce: The Difwych hunt is out in full cry across the eastern hills, chasing a boar twenty years gone - and running down anyone in the way.
stages.success: The hounds scatter - and something answers their horns. A boar, silver-bristled, as big as a cart.
stages.fail: The hunt rides on.

stages.name: Grugyn Silver-Bristle
stages.objective: Bring down Grugyn Silver-Bristle
stages.announce: Grugyn Silver-Bristle, son of the Twrch Trwyth, out of the old tales and into the hills: the brothers' horns have called up the boar they never caught. Bring friends.
stages.success: Grugyn falls, and the horns go quiet in the hills. For one night, at least, the Difwych hunt is over.
stages.fail: Grugyn crashes away into the hills, the hunt behind him.

stages.name: The Hunt Holds the Ridge Road
stages.objective: Drive the Difwych hounds off the ridge road
stages.announce: The Difwych hounds have spread down onto the ridge road and run down anyone they find.
stages.success: The road is clear again.

chains.title: The Door at Darkness Falls
chains.hint: Brimstone on the wind below Darkness Falls - the door is cracking again...

stages.name: Hold the Door
stages.objective: Keep Sergeant Ffion alive while the Watch shores up the door
stages.announce: The door to Darkness Falls is cracking! Sir Barwick's sergeant, Ffion, is holding it with the Watch while the masons work - and the demons are coming through.
stages.thanks: "Sir Barwick will want to hear of this. Barwick, mind. Not Berwick."
stages.success: The masons are done - and the thing that was pushing hardest comes through before the door closes.
stages.fail: Sergeant Ffion falls and the door swings open.

stages.name: Gorgoth the Door-Breaker
stages.objective: Defeat Gorgoth the Door-Breaker
stages.announce: Gorgoth the Door-Breaker, a grumoz the size of a haywain: 'BERWICK.' Bring friends.
stages.success: Gorgoth bursts like a coal in a fire. The door holds another month.
stages.fail: Gorgoth breaks through.

stages.name: Demons Hold the Barrow Road
stages.objective: Drive the demons off the road below Darkness Falls
stages.announce: Demons are loose below Darkness Falls and have taken the road.
stages.success: The road is clear again.
